decisions.reason: The firm launched the sewer pipe cleaning box only in 2024 and features it publicly, so management will attribute any slow uptake to the long municipal procurement cycle and keep it.
Public waste bins fit the firm's announced municipal street-furniture direction and have just been committed to publicly, so early weak results would be seen as temporary.
Ground sleeves for posts are the anchor of a newly built product family, so dropping them would undercut the earlier investment and the firm's visible commitment to the line.
The cast iron variant carries sunk tooling and sourcing costs and belongs to the announced sleeve range, so management will persist with it despite some overlap with the steel version.
Steel ground sleeves sit close to the firm's core metal fabrication capability and form part of the publicly presented sleeve range, so they will be kept.
